description: Add subtitles to video. Burn subtitles into the picture or attach them as a track. Burned-in subtitles show everywhere, even where nobody turns them on; attached ones the viewer can switch off, and the picture is not re-encoded. Accepts video/*, .mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .srt, .vtt, .ass, .ssa; up to 500 MB per file.

mode.description: What to do with the subtitles

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: video_subtitles
